archetypes.name: state-machine
archetypes.rationale: This diff introduces a new STEP3_REVIEW_LOOP_STATUS envelope alongside the existing LOOP_STATUS, plus intra-round phase markers (awaiting-apply/awaiting-post-apply/awaiting-continuation). The mapping between the two status enums and the post-loop branch matrix is a high-risk contract surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the dual-status design: `STEP3_REVIEW_LOOP_STATUS` (loop envelope) vs `LOOP_STATUS` (single-pass / legacy). Verify every `STEP3_REVIEW_LOOP_STATUS` value has a correct post-loop branch in SKILL.md and that the allowlist in the `case` guard at the parse fence is complete and consistent with the plan's enum definition. Check that the `.completed/step-3` write ordering is correct: it must happen before any Step 3b transition in loop mode and via `design-step3-state.sh --gate-b-bypass` in legacy single-pass bypass paths — confirm the new prose does not leave a window where a crash after the loop returns but before `.completed/step-3` is written could mis-route a resume. Trace the HARD-fail `postplan-failed` path to confirm it never writes `.completed/step-3` or transitions to Step 3b. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sole-writer-invariant
archetypes.rationale: The plan explicitly names 'review-round-count.txt sole-writer violation / wrong rollback set' as failure mode #1. The diff refactors the shared round-body to thread --prune-round-num explicitly while changing plan-review-loop.sh to no longer read that file — this must hold across all calling paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that after the diff, `plan-review-loop.sh` contains no read of `review-round-count.txt` (the plan says it 'defaults to `--round-num` without reading `$DESIGN_TMPDIR/review-round-count.txt`'). Confirm the `--prune-round-num "$STEP3_REVIEW_ROUND_NUM"` argument is always supplied by the shared round-body before calling `plan-review-loop.sh`, and that no call site omits it in the new loop controller. Check the rollback set: rollback must happen only on `tally-error` and `degraded-empty-collector`; `panel-failed` must persist. Confirm the `test-design-structure.sh` pin change (absent→contains for `--prune-round-num`) aligns with the actual `run-step3-review.sh` change and `plan-review-loop.md` update. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
